moments.description: A blank black screen is shown.
The TodoMVC app loads with the header "todos" and input placeholder "What needs to be done?" while the cursor moves around idly.
The user types "Buy milk" into the input field and presses Enter to add it to the list.
The user enters "Finish the hackathon demo video" into the input box and submits it.
The user types "Call mom" into the text field and submits.
The user types "fix lgoin bug", corrects the typo to "fix login bug", and presses Enter.
The user moves the mouse cursor around the screen without interacting with any elements.
The user checks the checkboxes next to "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" to mark them complete.
The user pauses and hovers the cursor over the list items.
The user clicks the "Active" filter button to display only uncompleted tasks.
The user clicks the "Completed" filter button to display completed tasks.
The user clicks "Active" and then "All" to view all todo items again.
The user clicks the "Completed" filter tab.
